content.title: OS (Parks & Open Space) District
content.summary: The OS (Parks & Open Space) District aims to preserve open land from urban development for parks and recreational areas. Various uses are classified under allowed, limited, or conditional categories, with specific regulations outlined in the Land Development Code for each use type, including recreation, community services, utilities, and agriculture. If a use is not specified, it is not permitted in this zoning district.
content.body:
Provided for the purpose of preserving tracts of open land from urban development, and for the preservation of land for parks, open space, and recreational areas

Acronyms:

- Allowed Use By-Right (A)
- Limited Use (L)
- Conditional Use (C)

**Note**: If a use is not listed in the table then it is not allowed in the zoning district
